title: Armed Burglary Suspect Exits Window and Opens Fire on Fort Wayne Officer
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Fort Wayne, Indiana — On June 13, 2024, at approximately 4:44 p.m., Fort Wayne Police Officers were dispatched to a residence in the 4700 block of Holton Ave in reference to a Burglary in progress. Upon arrival, Officer Minardo went to the back of the residence to assist with securing the home. Officer Minardo encountered a suspect, exiting a window. The suspect, who was armed with a .45 caliber handgun, sees Officer Minardo and instantly begins shooting at him. The handgun the suspect used was converted to a fully automatic gun with a Glock switch. Officer Minardo was struck in the arm and returned fire. 

Officer Minardo falls back and sees another suspect fleeing the area. Officer Minardo gives chase and radios the suspect location before he is rendered aid. Officer Schroeder also encounters the suspect and discharges his weapon. The shooting suspect was located a few hours later and was taken into custody. The suspect was then taken to the hospital for care. Once the suspect was cleared from the hospital, the suspect was taken to jail and charged. The suspect, 20-year-old Zar Myint, pled guilty to attempted murder. Zar Myint was sentenced to 30 years in prison. Officer Minardo is continuing to recover from the shooting.
